headline: Committee discusses Bill 77-2026 on Affordable Housing Fund use for houseless residents

meeting.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meeting.summary: The housing director said the fund's current wording is broad enough and suggested softening the word ensure. The chair said the committee would probably defer the bill and invite the Director of Human Concerns. A safe parking program is planned for June 29th.
meeting.recap: The committee had one item: Bill 77-2026, on using the Affordable Housing Fund for the county's houseless population.[[0:03:38]] The chair said HUD, the federal housing agency, has restructured its homeless-services funding since June 1st.[[0:05:00]] Another testifier said she strongly supports Bill 77.[[0:42:14]] The chair said the bill defines "houseless" and directs part of the fund to houseless residents.[[0:46:32]] The housing director said the fund's current wording is broad enough, so the bill could be seen as redundant.[[0:52:58]] The housing director recommended softening the bill's word "ensure," which the director said can be read as a guarantee.[[1:33:36]] The department plans to evaluate a parcel of more than 100 acres in South Kīhei for development.[[1:37:40]] The chair said the committee would probably defer the bill and invite the Director of Human Concerns.[[1:38:45]] On June 29th, the committee plans to discuss a safe parking program.[[1:51:24]]
meeting.next: The chair said Director Willis of Human Concerns will be invited to join the committee on this bill. The housing director said the department will share its list of county properties that could be developed for housing. The chair said staff will take note of members' support for the housing director's suggested wording changes. The chair said the committee will focus on this topic for the next couple months.

moments.q: "I'm not ready to vote on something like this."
